firmware.name: Touch FX
firmware.author: Synthux Academy
firmware.description: Delay, reverb, three drives and three bit crushers for the Simple Touch.
firmware.notes:
## Touch FX
Source: [Synthux-Academy/TouchFX](https://github.com/Synthux-Academy/TouchFX).

## Pads
- **P00 / P03 / P04** · drive A / B / C
- **P02 / P06 / P07** · bit crush A / B / C
- **P05** · bypass
- **P08** · delay bypass
- **P09** · reverb bypass

## Hold a pad, turn a knob
- **S34** with a drive or crush pad held · that effect's amount (without a pad: reverb send)
- **S35** with a drive or crush pad held · that effect's mix (without a pad: reverb mix)

## Switch
- **S07-S08** · up: pads latch, other positions: momentary
